body.query: source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where elb_status_code = 504
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where elb_status_code >= 500 | stats count() as error_count by elb_status_code, span(`@timestamp`, 5m)
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats count() as requestCount by elb_status_code, span(@timestamp, 5m) as time_bin | sort - time_bin
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | eval is_err = if(elb_status_code >= 400, 1, 0) | stats count() as requests, sum(is_err) as errors by span(@timestamp, 1h) as hour | sort hour

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | eval e = if(elb_status_code > 499, 1, 0) | stats count() as total_requests, sum(e) as errors | eval error_rate_pct = round(errors * 100.0 / total_requests, 4)
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where elb_status_code >= 500 | stats count() as requestCount by url_path | sort - requestCount
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where elb_status_code >= 500 | sort - `@timestamp`, trace_id | head 1000
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats count() as c by elb_status_code, target_status_code | sort - c, elb_status_code, target_status_code
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats count() as count by client_ip | sort - count
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats count() as c by http_method, client_ip | sort - c, http_method, client_ip | head 100
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats count() as count by client_ip, elb, request_url | sort - count
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where like(user_agent, '%Safari%') | sort `@timestamp`, trace_id | head 10 | fields request_url

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where like(request, '%.env%') or like(request, '%admin%') or like(request, '%login%') or like(request, '%cgi-bin%') or like(request, '%remote/login%') or like(request, '%+CSCOE+%') | stats count() as scanAttempts, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by client_ip, user_agent | sort - scanAttempts | head 20

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where target_processing_time > 0 | eval err = if(elb_status_code >= 500, 1, 0) | stats count() as requests, percentile(target_processing_time, 99) as latency_p99, sum(err) as errors by user_agent, http_method, url_path | where requests >= 10 | sort - latency_p99 | head 25

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where target_processing_time > 0 | stats count() as requests, avg(target_processing_time) as avg_latency, percentile(target_processing_time, 99) as p99_latency by target_ip | sort - avg_latency

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where target_processing_time != -1 | stats avg(target_processing_time) as avg_latency, percentile(target_processing_time, 50) as p50, percentile(target_processing_time, 90) as p90, percentile(target_processing_time, 99) as p99 by span(@timestamp, 5m) as time_bin | sort - time_bin
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where target_processing_time >= 0 | stats percentile_approx(target_processing_time, 95) as p95, count() as c by elb_status_code | sort elb_status_code

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats avg(request_processing_time) as average_request_processing_time, avg(target_processing_time) as average_target_processing_time, avg(response_processing_time) as average_response_processing_time

source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | where target_processing_time > 5 | sort - target_processing_time | head 1000 | fields `@timestamp`, request_url, target_processing_time, elb_status_code, target_status_code
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | timechart span=1h count() by elb_status_code
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | stats distinct_count(client_ip) as unique_clients
source = {{index_name | default('elb_logs')}} | eval mb = received_bytes / 1000000.0 | stats sum(mb) as client_datareceived_megabytes by client_ip | sort - client_datareceived_megabytes
